p.h1: Architectural Decision Record (ADR-0042): Zero Trust Service Mesh Migration

ac:rich-text-body.p: This document defines the cryptographic mutual TLS (mTLS) enforcement policy across all production Kubernetes ingress and egress topologies for PCI-DSS 4.0 compliance.

p: Legacy internal services currently communicate over plaintext HTTP within AWS VPC boundaries. Security compliance mandates hardware-backed SPIFFE/SPIRE cryptographic workload identity attestation and end-to-end TLS 1.3 encryption across all cluster nodes.
We adopt Istio Ambient Mesh with ztunnel for L4 mTLS encryption and waypoint proxies for fine-grained L7 authorization policies.

ul.li: Zero sidecar overhead on application pods
Transparent mTLS with automated x509 certificate renewal every 12 hours
Strict peer authentication across prod-banking and prod-checkout namespaces

pre: apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1 kind: PeerAuthentication metadata: name: default namespace: prod-banking spec: mtls: mode: STRICT
p: All ingress controllers must reject TLS 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The following cipher suites are strictly enforced:

ul.li: TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 (Default for AES-NI hardware accelerated hosts)
